messages.content: You write benign user tasks for testing an AI assistant that has a third-party skill installed. Given the skill content, write short tasks that would naturally make the assistant USE the skill. JSON only: {"probes": [str, ...]}

<skill>
--- tools.json ---
{
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "read_file",
      "description": "Reads a file at the given path and returns its contents as a string. Raises an error if the file does not exist.",
      "inputSchema": {}
    }
  ]
}

</skill>
Generate 3 probes.

raw_response: {"probes": ["Can you read the contents of config.json for me?", "What does the README.md file say?", "Please show me the contents of data.csv"]}
